def feat(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cs=comps([row[:] for row in g])
    out={}
    for i,(sz,cells) in enumerate(cs):
        if sz==0: continue
        ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
        cset=set(cells)
        for (y,x) in cells:
            n=sum(1 for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if (y+dy,x+dx) in cset)
            ds=sorted((abs(y-y0)+abs(x-x0)) for y0,x0 in cells)
            dmin=ds[0] if ds else 9
            # second min
            k=[d for d in ds if d!=dmin]
            dnext=min(k) if k else 9
            m=sum((y+y0)+(x+x0) for y0,x0 in cells)/sz
            m=(y+y0)+(x+x0)
            r=y-sum(ys)/len(ys); cc=x-sum(xs)/len(xs)
            key=('d'+str(dmin),'nd'+str(n),'nmax'+str(max(ds)))
            out[(y,x)]=out.get(key,[0])+[g[y][x]]
    return out
